claim: Gassin sits 8 km from Saint-Tropez and 2.5 km from Ramatuelle, classed among France's Most Beautiful Villages, with the Androuno, the world's narrowest street at 29 cm.
quote: Gassin is located 8 kilometers from Saint-Tropez and 2.5 kilometers from Ramatuelle ... one of the Most Beautiful Villages in France ... the Androuno, the narrowest street in the world at 29 centimeters wide.

claim: Ramatuelle is a hilltop village (village perché) about 10 km southwest of Saint-Tropez with views over the Gulf and narrow streets lined with coloured shutters and bougainvillea.
quote: Ramatuelle is around 10 kilometres to the south west of Saint Tropez ... a striking feature of the Provence landscape, clinging to a hillside ... gorgeous narrow streets lined with coloured shutters and vibrant pink bougainvillea trees.

claim: Grimaud, ~12 km northwest of Saint-Tropez, offers a half-day taking in the 11th/12th-century castle ruins, Saint-Michel church, Saint-Roch mill and the Pont des Fées, then the canal town of Port Grimaud.
quote: In half a day, you can visit the castle, Saint-Michel Church, Saint-Roch Mill, and the Pont des Fées, then head down to the lakeside town of Port Grimaud for a complete change of atmosphere.

claim: Port Grimaud, the 'Little Venice of Provence', was designed in the 1960s by architect François Spoerry so each house has direct water access; explore on foot, by electric boat or water taxi, ~15 min drive from Saint-Tropez.
quote: conceived in the 1960s by visionary architect François Spoerry, who designed the town so that each residence has direct water access ... You can explore on foot, by electric boat or using water taxis

claim: Domaine Tropez in Gassin runs a €20/person guided tour and tasting of 7 estate wines (English Thursdays 11am, French Wednesdays 11am, no reservation), plus chocolate-and-wine pairing from €140 for two; cellar open year-round.
quote: €20 per person; free for under 18 ... visit the winery ... tasting of 7 estate wines ... English: Thursdays at 11:00 AM ... Chocolate & Wine Pairing: €140 for 2 people

claim: The Ramatuelle peninsula holds numerous Côtes de Provence estates with cellar tastings, including Vignobles de Ramatuelle (cooperative, ~70% rosé), Domaine la Tourraque (since 1805), Château des Marres on the Route des Plages, and Le Mas de Pampelonne (year-round cellar tastings).
quote: Le Mas de Pampelonne - 15-hectare domain established in 1886, offering 'sale in the cellar' with tastings available year-round ... Domaine la Tourraque - Operating since 1805

claim: Vignobles de Ramatuelle groups winegrowers from Ramatuelle, Gassin, La Croix Valmer and Saint-Tropez producing AOP Côtes de Provence, with free tasting in the cellar on the road to Escalet beach; Château Volterra in Ramatuelle hosted 1930s/40s celebrities and majors on red wine (65% of output).
quote: taste these wines free of charge in their cellar on the road leading to the splendid Escalet beach ... Château Volterra ... celebrities including Josephine Baker, Marcel Pagnol and Jean Cocteau ... red wines which represent 65% of the production

claim: Boat excursions in the Gulf depart from Sainte-Maxime and Cavalaire-sur-Mer to Porquerolles, Port-Cros and the Îles d'Hyères, plus coastal routes to Les 3 Caps Sauvages and the red Calanques de l'Estérel.
quote: Porquerolles - described as the 'pearl' of the Golden Isles ... Port-Cros - a national park ... Les 3 Caps Sauvages (Cap Taillat, Cap Camarat, Cap Lardier) ... Calanques de l'Estérel - featuring 'crimson rock' cliffs

claim: A full-day Porquerolles cruise from Sainte-Maxime departs ~9:30am and returns ~7:30pm, with adult fares around €48.90 to €51.50.
quote: Departures are at 9:30 am with returns around 7:30 pm, and adult prices range from 48.90 to 51.50 €.
